name: Ran
source:
The one among the Oni Clan that can summon Onryou. 
[spoiler]She is the Priestess of the Black Dragon and she controls the yin aspect of the Ryuujin.
Ran is actually Tenma's long lost sister, whom Akuram abducted.[/spoiler]
